ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: According to news from the British Daily Mail, the latest satellite photos show that the Arctic has become an island for the first time in human history. To dynamically display the changes in the area of Arctic glaciers over nearly 30 years and predict their changing trend, which technical means needs to be applied?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to news from the British Daily Mail, the latest satellite photos show that the Arctic has become an island for the first time in human history. To dynamically display the changes in the area of Arctic glaciers over nearly 30 years and predict their changing trend, which technical means needs to be applied?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure shows two images of the Arctic region arranged side by side on the left and right; the left image is labeled 1979, and the right image is labeled 2008. It can be directly seen that the ice and snow range in the same region has clearly shrunk, reflecting comparative changes in different periods. Then reason: the question stem requires "dynamically displaying" the changes in glacier area over nearly 30 years and "predicting its changing trend". This requires storing, overlaying, analyzing, visualizing, and judging trends for multi-period spatial data. The technical means that has these functions is a geographic information system, so the answer is geographic information system.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：图中左右并列显示北极地区两个时期的影像或地图，左下标注为1979，右下标注为2008，体现的是同一区域冰川或海冰范围随时间变化的对比。再读题干：要求“动态显示”北极冰川面积近30年的变化，并“预测其变化趋势”。由此判断所需技术不只是获取卫星照片，而是对多年空间数据进行存储、叠加、动态展示、分析和趋势预测。具备这些空间数据管理与分析功能的是地理信息系统，因此答案为地理信息系统。
